summary: Tested the new Service Detail pages feature end-to-end: (1) Services listing shows both 'Explore service' and 'Request consultation' links, (2) ServiceDetail renders stats/overview/technologies/deliverables/process/why/FAQ with correct counts, (3) FAQ accordion expands and collapses (chevron rotates), (4) Next service link navigates correctly (web-development -> mobile-app-development), (5) All 10 slug URLs render /services/<slug> successfully with no redirects, (6) Admin content edit round-trip verified: logged in at /admin, opened Services tab, confirmed new fields (Slug/Overview/What we deliver/Technologies/Stats/Process/Why/FAQ) all present, edited Web Development overview with a marker, saved via 'Save changes', confirmed marker visible on public /services/web-development, then restored original value. Backend GET /api/content returns 10 services, each populated with slug, overview, deliverables(5), process(4), technologies(6), stats(2-3), whyUs(3), faq(3). No critical or minor issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: ServiceDetail.jsx uses `services.indexOf(s)` after `find` — redundant pass but harmless; could use findIndex for a tiny perf win.

If a service object is missing a `slug`, Services.jsx conditionally hides the Explore link but ServiceDetail would still be reachable only by direct URL — acceptable, but consider admin validation to require slug uniqueness.
seed_data_creation: None. Added a temporary [TESTEDIT...] marker to Web Development overview during round-trip test, then restored to the original string. A stale marker from an earlier run was found on servicesPage.sub (`From the first wireframe...`) and was also cleaned up during this iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin content editor has 91 textareas on Services tab; textarea index 0 = services page subtext, then every service block starts a group 'Service NN — Title'. For Service 01 (Web Development), index 1 = short desc, index 2 = overview, index 3 = card features, index 4 = deliverables, index 5 = technologies, index 6 = stats, index 7 = process, index 8 = whyUs, index 9 = faq. The 'Save changes' button triggers PUT /api/admin/content and public pages reflect changes immediately after reload (no caching issue observed). data-testids on public detail: service-detail-page, service-back, service-stat, service-tech, process-step, why-card, faq-toggle, next-service-link.
